text.la: Exsultávit cor meum in Dómino, et exaltátum est cornu meum in Deo meo.
text.en-US: My heart hath rejoiced in the Lord, and my horn is exalted in my God:

text.la: Dilatátum est os meum super inimícos meos: quia laetáta sum in salutári tuo.
text.en-US: My mouth is enlarged over my enemies: because I have joyed in thy salvation.

text.la: Non est sanctus, ut est Dóminus: neque enim est álius extra te, et non est fortis sicut Deus noster.
text.en-US: There is none holy as the Lord is: for there is no other beside thee, and there is none strong like our God.
Do not multiply to speak lofty things, boasting:

text.la: Recédant vétera de ore vestro: quia Deus scientiárum, Dóminus est, et ipsi praeparántur cogitatiónes.
text.en-US: Let old matters depart from your mouth: for the Lord is a God of all knowledge, and to him are thoughts prepared.

text.la: Arcus fórtium superátus est, et infírmi accíncti sunt róbore.
text.en-US: The bow of the mighty is overcome, and the weak are girt with strength.

text.la: Repléti prius, pro pánibus se locavérunt: et famélici saturáti sunt.
text.en-US: They that were full before have hired out themselves for bread: and the hungry are filled,

text.la: Donec stérilis péperit plúrimos: et quae multos habébat fílios, infirmáta est.
text.en-US: So that the barren hath borne many: and she that had many children is weakened.

text.la: Dóminus mortíficat et vivíficat, dedúcit ad ínferos et redúcit.
text.en-US: The Lord killeth and maketh alive, he bringeth down to hell and bringeth back again.

text.la: Dóminus páuperem facit et ditat, humíliat et súblevat.
text.en-US: The Lord maketh poor and maketh rich, he humbleth and he exalteth.

text.la: Súscitat de púlvere egénum, et de stércore élevat páuperem:
text.en-US: He raiseth up the needy from the dust, and lifteth up the poor from the dunghill:

text.la: Ut sédeat cum princípibus, et sólium glóriae téneat.
text.en-US: That he may sit with princes, and hold the throne of glory.

text.la: Dómini enim sunt cárdines terrae, et pósuit super eos orbem.
text.en-US: For the poles of the earth are the Lord's, and upon them he hath set the world.

text.la: Pedes sanctórum suórum servábit, et ímpii in ténebris conticéscent: quia non in fortitúdine sua roborábitur vir.
text.en-US: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness, because no man shall prevail by his own strength.

text.la: Dóminum formidábunt adversárii eius: et super ipsos in caelis tonábit:
text.en-US: The adversaries of the Lord shall fear him: and upon them shall he thunder in the heavens.

text.la: Dóminus iudicábit fines terrae, et dabit impérium regi suo, et sublimábit cornu Christi sui.
text.en-US: The Lord shall judge the ends of the earth, and he shall give empire to his king, and shall exalt the horn of his Christ.
